prompt: Create a high-fidelity UI concept board for AniRec, an anime recommendation web app, using the attached real PySide screenshots as visual authority. Output a landscape 2-by-2 board of FOUR actual desktop app viewports: top-left MY LIBRARY, top-right PROFILE, bottom-left COMPARE, bottom-right SETTINGS. Each viewport should have its own compact indexed left navigation rail and enough usable content to judge its layout. No perspective, no device frames, no marketing poster, no floating decoration. Highest practical resolution, legible large-enough text. References contribute green-black surfaces, bone text, brass personal signals, aqua secondary/community signals, compact monospaced headings and readable prose, thin borders and square panels. Preserve these precisely, but do NOT copy the original page geometry. Background #070C09, panels #0C1410, text #C6D4C2, brass #D9A441, aqua #5FBFB5. Keep clear rectangular focus/selection treatments and quiet surfaces without neon glow. Every viewport must visibly say SAMPLE DATA / LAYOUT CONCEPT. Shared rail: ANIREC, 01 Discover, 02 My Library, 03 Profile, 04 Compare, 05 Settings; highlight the correct tab. No invented capability claims, no recommendations advertised as watched history. Use initials poster placeholders as the real reference does, not fake anime artwork. Specific content: Library is saved recommendation decisions, Watch later and Not interested; show 3 illustrative saved titles Monster, Death Note, Steins;Gate, explicitly a sample layout. Profile is anirec_sample, completed 312, mean score 7.42; taste overlap 72%, rating bias -0.43, contrarian 31%; evidence Kotoura-san YOU 9 / COMMUNITY 6.7, Gakkougurashi! YOU 9 / COMMUNITY 7.4. Compare is anirec_sample with NeoBalls_, overlap 78%, shared 96, both rated 74; ratings Evangelion YOU 9 / FRIEND 3, One Piece YOU 4 / FRIEND 9, Spirited Away YOU 10 / FRIEND 6. Settings has Recommendation, Appearance, Account and Local data; adventurousness familiar-to-surprising, batch size 10, default sort Personal match, show covers, account not connected. Do not show authentication tokens or fake successful sync. Prioritize the structure described next over the reference layout. DIRECTION B: SPLIT WORKBENCH. The dominant structure in every viewport is a narrow browse column paired with a larger persistent detail pane, inside the existing indexed rail. Library: saved-title list on the left with Monster selected, large right inspector with MN initials poster, Personal match 94.6%, MAL 8.87, metadata and Remove from Watch later action. Profile: left list of taste signals with Rating bias selected, right detail explains -0.43 below the community, with Kotoura-san and Gakkougurashi! evidence rows; identity compact above. Compare: left disagreement list with Evangelion selected; right pane gives big paired YOU 9 and FRIEND 3 plus MAL 8.35, all labeled, with a small 78% overlap summary above the list. Settings: left section list Recommendation/Appearance/Account/Local data; right focused Recommendation form with explanatory help and explicitly labeled controls. Workbench headers preserve browse context and selections. It should look focused, flexible, inviting, compact yet breathable. Do not fall back to grids of stat cards or full-width tables.
